quote: Pray as though everything depended on God. Work as though everything depended on you.
author: St. Augustine of Hippo

quote: Late have I loved you, beauty so old and so new: late have I loved you.
author: St. Augustine of Hippo

quote: Our hearts are restless until they rest in You.
author: St. Augustine of Hippo

quote: Preach the Gospel at all times and when necessary use words.
author: St. Francis of Assisi

quote: To love God is something greater than to know Him.
author: St. Thomas Aquinas

quote: The things that we love tell us what we are.
author: St. Thomas Aquinas

quote: Let nothing disturb you, let nothing frighten you. All things are passing; God alone suffices.
author: St. Teresa of Ávila

quote: Miss no single opportunity of making some small sacrifice.
author: St. Thérèse of Lisieux

quote: Do not be afraid. Do not be satisfied with mediocrity. Put out into the deep and let down your nets.
author: St. John Paul II

quote: Be who God meant you to be and you will set the world on fire.
author: St. Catherine of Siena

quote: Not all of us can do great things. But we can do small things with great love.
author: St. Teresa of Calcutta

quote: He who possesses God lacks nothing: God alone suffices.
author: St. Teresa of Ávila

quote: Start by doing what's necessary; then do what's possible; and suddenly you are doing the impossible.
author: St. Francis of Assisi

quote: Christ has no body now on earth but yours, no hands but yours, no feet but yours.
author: St. Teresa of Ávila

quote: Love is shown more in deeds than in words.
author: St. Ignatius of Loyola

quote: Act as if every day were the last of your life.
author: St. Anthony of Padua

quote: Spread love everywhere you go. Let no one ever come to you without leaving happier.
author: St. Teresa of Calcutta

quote: Sanctify yourself and you will sanctify society.
author: St. Francis of Assisi

quote: Patience is the companion of wisdom.
author: St. Augustine of Hippo

quote: The truth is like a lion; you don't have to defend it. Let it loose; it will defend itself.
author: St. Augustine of Hippo
